added.title: Vice President, Engineering
added.description:
Voyant Beauty believes our people are more than just employees; they’re the driving force behind everything we achieve. Our culture fosters teamwork, respect, and camaraderie, ensuring that every individual’s contribution is valued and celebrated. We invest in their growth, providing opportunities for development and advancement within our dynamic team.

Voyant Beauty is a company that specializes in the development and manufacturing, of beauty, personal and home care products. We work with various brands, retailers, and businesses to create customer formulations and products tailored to their needs. This can include skincare, haircare, bath and body products, fragrances, and more. Essentially, Voyant Beauty serves as a one-stop-shop for companies looking to bring their beauty and personal care product ideas to life.

Safety is a core value at Voyant Beauty. We prioritize the well-being of our team members, ensuring a safe and secure environment where everyone can thrive and excel.

If you’re seeking to be part of a team where your talents are valued, your safety is paramount, and your efforts contribute to meaningful change, then Voyant Beauty is the place for you. Come join us and be a part of our journey.

A Brief Overview

The Vice President of Engineering is a strategic and operational leader responsible for overseeing all engineering functions within a fast-paced co-manufacturing environment. This executive role drives innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence across multiple product lines and facilities. The VP of Engineering leads cross-functional teams in project engineering, process engineering, purified water system engineering, maintenance and reliability, capital planning and execution, automation, and technical services to ensure high-quality production and operational efficiency aligned with customer requirements and company growth objectives.

What You Will Do

Define and drive the engineering, maintenance and facilities infrastructure strategy aligned with corporate goals; identify technology and process investments to support business growth, scalability, and customer expectations; own a multi-year engineering roadmap with clear prioritization and trade-offs. Oversee facilities engineering, including site layout, utilities, and infrastructure upgrades. Manage maintenance programs, reliability initiatives, and preventive/predictive maintenance strategies. Ensure facilities and infrastructure meet operational, safety, and environmental standards.
Own the engineering capital expenditure budget, forecasting, and scenario planning, including facility expansions or strategic closures, new equipment installations, and automation initiatives. Oversee ROI analyses, project timelines, and stakeholder communication in collaboration with each site. Lead cross-functional project teams to deliver engineering initiatives on time and within budget.
Guide continuous improvement efforts in process design, quality assurance, production efficiency, and sustainability. Collaborate with operations and quality to reduce waste, downtime, and variability. Manage change management for process improvements and technology upgrades. Drive reliability programs to reduce downtime and improve equipment performance.
Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary engineering team (process, packaging, facilities, maintenance). Ensure ongoing development, succession planning, and performance management.
Partner with Commercial, R&D, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to launch new products, resolve technical challenges, and enhance customer satisfaction.
Ensure all engineering and maintenance activities meet regulatory, safety, and environmental standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, GMP, OSHA). Champion safety-first culture.
Represent engineering, facilities infrastructure and maintenance & reliability-leadership in executive strategy meetings, customer presentations, and board updates.
Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies and systems (e.g., smart manufacturing and flow to the customer).
Develop and manage engineering budgets, timelines, and KPIs.
Oversee third-party contractors, consultants, and vendors.
Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, and operational excellence.

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Industrial). (Required) or
Master's Degree in Engineering, MBA, or related field (Preferred)

Experience Qualifications

10+ years Minimum 15 years of progressive engineering leadership experience, with at least 5 years in a senior/executive role within a contract manufacturing, personal care, CPG, or food/personal care/pharmaceutical industry. (Required)
10+ years Proven success managing multi-site engineering operations and leading capital investment programs exceeding $10M. (Required)
10+ years Proven success in leading and managing Facilities Engineering as well as Maintenance and Reliability of infrastructure and manufacturing assets. (Required)

Skills And Abilities

Ability to align engineering vision with corporate goals and long-term growth strategies. (High proficiency)
Mastery in planning, budgeting, and executing large-scale capital projects in a manufacturing environment. (High proficiency)
Understanding of lean six-sigma principles and continuous improvement tools (e.g., Kaizen, Gemba, Root Cause and Corrective Action, Problem Solving Techniques, DMAIC). (High proficiency)
In-depth knowledge of manufacturing systems, equipment, automation, and packaging technologies. (High proficiency)
Ability to lead, coach, and inspire engineering teams at all levels. (High proficiency)
Skilled in presenting to executives, managing stakeholders, and fostering cross-functional alignment. (High proficiency)
Familiarity with FDA, GMP, ISO, OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulations. (High proficiency)
Commitment to delivering high-value technical solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations. (High proficiency)

added.title: Director, Operations Engineering
added.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Director, Operations Engineering
located in Austin, TX .

Reporting to the General Manager
the Director, Operations Engineering
role is responsible for managing engineering department - specifying, designing, installing, supporting manufacturing and maintaining automation equipment, Tooling , Controls Engineering and Reliability Engineering applications as required to meet specifications.

What a typical day looks like:

Able to manage/develop/coach automation engineering team to meet automation goals.
Able to design from low to complex automation solutions for Final Assembly, Testing and Packaging including equipment, processes and tools.
Participate in design reviews. Understand mechanical drawings, electrical and pneumatic diagrams identifying potential risk and errors.
Manage projects within budget and time constraints.
Willing to travel and collaborate with sites on automation requirement.
Able to forecast diligently on execution plan with interest to achieve implementation.
Manage startup efforts, commission automation system and training for engineers plus technician.
Implement cost effective automation, with transparent quotation process.
Provide status reports as per established schedule with ability to drive for implementation.
Ability to identify and manage areas of risk in design documentation/specifications.
Prepare and maintain documentation related to the operation of the automation equipment.
Requires a strong work ethic, negotiating skills and an innovation mindset.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience and training plus a minimum of 8 years of management experience.
A Master’s or MBA degree is preferred.
High speed automation experience
Great leadership and communication experience
Experience in large size companies
Manufacturing experience
Establish and drive initiatives for department and production KPIs
Ability to hire and/or move resources across the organization in order to meet priorities and deadlines
Understanding of medical validation processes (IQ/OQ/PQ)
Experience in building an engineering organization and managing 300 people or more
Support of a 24/7 production operation
Experience working in a cross-metrics organization
Supporting an organization coexisting with the customer on site.
Experience in an FDA regulated manufacturing environment (Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food or Consumer industries)..
FDA Audit Experience (Preferred).
